messages:
Noah Kim: hey folks, quick onboarding snag. I tried to access Console (staging) > Feature Flags to flip a demo flag and got a 403. demo in ~1.5h, any quick path to a temporary role? :grimacing:
Riley Park: welcome Noah! :wave: can you paste the error text and your console email? staging-only ok?
Noah Kim: sure — noah.kim@redwood.com and staging-only ok. error: `{"status":403, "err":"permission_denied", "detail":"missing role: feature_flags_admin"}`
AccessBot: Request queued (REQ-4722). Verified user exists, no conflicting elevated roles. Approval request sent to Riley Park and Taylor Brooks.
Taylor Brooks: I can approve a short staging grant. Riley, is 2 hours our standard for demo access?
Riley Park: yeah 2h is fine. make sure it expires and is logged.
DevOnboardBot: note added to Noah's onboarding checklist: "how to request temporary feature-flag access".
Taylor Brooks: approved. Granting `feature_flags_admin (staging)` for 2 hours to noah.kim@redwood.com. Audit id: REQ-4722.
Riley Park: Noah — can you confirm you can open the flag page and toggle the demo flag?
Noah Kim: confirmed I can see the flags and toggled `ui_demo_mode`. thanks! saved the audit id in my runbook.
Noah Kim: quick Q: after demo, how do I request a long-term change to the flag? who owns these usually?
Riley Park: open flag details in Console -> Owner field. if empty ping #feature-flags with the flag id and we’ll route. CLI option: `rfctl flags describe ui_demo_mode --env staging`.
Taylor Brooks: also add the audit id to the Flag Change log (Confluence). Security asked us to always include request ids for temporary grants.
Noah Kim: got it, added. really appreciate the quick help everyone :pray:
Riley Park: welcome aboard Noah, shout here for anything else. :tada:
